metadata.description: Plugins von Krynex Labs: Cyberbrain (lokales, zitierendes Projekt-Gedächtnis) und AgentGuard (Freigabe vor jedem Werkzeugaufruf eines Agenten).

plugins.name: cyberbrain
plugins.description: Local, cited project memory for coding agents: notes as Markdown, trust rings, hybrid search without network, GDPR erasure and an audit chain.

plugins.name: agentguard
plugins.description: Asks your AgentGuard service before each shell command, file write and web fetch: shadow mode records, enforce mode carries out deny and ask and fails safe.
